items.title: Scientific statistical model contract
items.statement: A model contract records the observation space, unit and index roles, observed and latent quantities, target population and estimand, observation mechanism, support, probability law, conditioning convention, and epistemic status of adequacy assumptions. It proves no physical applicability or identifiability.
items.strategy: Definition only: specify each field and make explicit that the contract establishes no empirical or physical truth.

title: Scientific model contracts and applicability — Examples

items.title: Biological units, repeated visits, and technical assay replicates
items.statement: A finite randomization model distinguishes eight participant-level assignment units from repeated visits and three technical readings per specimen, with a joint design law and an explicit finite-schedule target.
items.strategy: Verify the uniform assignment law, the measurable observation map, the finite-schedule estimand, the support, and the bookkeeping of units and indices.

items.title: An unvalidated calibration offset leaves the true quantity unidentified
items.statement: In the deterministic reading model R=q+b with unknown true quantity q and calibration offset b, distinct parameter pairs have the same observation law and different q values.
items.strategy: Use a one-unit shift of q compensated by the opposite shift of b, then verify equality of Dirac laws and inequality of the estimand.
